title: PDXOSGeo
tagline: Charting the course for open source
description: The Portland chapter of OSGeo: monthly meetups about open data, maps, and spatial applications.
defaultLocation: Hot Lips Pizza @ the Natural Capital Center: 721 NW 9th Ave, Portland OR
about: The Portland chapter of OSGeo is focused on learning and teaching about open data, maps, and spatial applications. We like good conversations about solving problems with open source tools.

joinLinks.label: Slack
joinLinks.blurb: Chat with PDXOSGeo folks and a wider geospatial crowd in The Spatial Community Slack. It is the fastest way to ask a question, share a map, or see who is heading to the next meetup.

joinLinks.label: Google Group
joinLinks.blurb: The pdx-osgeo mailing list is where meeting announcements, recaps, and longer threads live. Subscribe if you want the monthly reminder in your inbox without hanging out in chat.

joinLinks.label: GitHub
joinLinks.blurb: This website is open source. File an issue, suggest a Map of the Month, or send a pull request if you want to help keep the site current.
